source.source_locator: 教則 第4章 4.4「無人航空機の主たる構成要素」(2)モーター、ローター（プロペラ）

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: ローター形状は回転方向に対応しており、motor rotationと一致させて取り付ける。
evidence.tested_misconception: CW/CCW用の形状差はなく任意に装着できる。
evidence.reasoning_path: propeller shape -> motor rotation direction -> correct installation

collision.note: LOW。既存bankでpropeller rotation-direction installationは未出。

independent_review.rationale: 4.4 requires rotor/propeller shape to match CW/CCW motor rotation direction; no canonical installation-direction item exists.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review is source-consistent, preserves second-class scope, and correctly rejects two sensor-fact candidates whose answer-defining propositions are already represented in released questions. The remaining 28 candidates cover distinct Chapter 4 system characteristics, equipment boundaries, sensor principles, powertrain/battery behavior, and radio propagation with useful commercial practice value.
